why: Replace the scaffold placeholders in overview.md, domains/README.md and standards/README.md of mods/bitshifter with content read from the node.

ops.body: Bitshifter is an Oxygen Not Included mod that lets the Automation Ribbon Reader and Ribbon Writer select any of bits 1 to 31 instead of 1 to 4, so one ribbon can carry up to 31 independent signals. The bit selector side screen lists Bit 1 to Bit 31 in a scroll view, both buildings show the selected bit on an amber two-digit display with a light for that bit's state, and a NOT gate on a ribbon inverts all 31 bits. The mod steps aside and logs it when Digital CPU is enabled or another mod already patches the reader's or writer's bit depth. Version 1.2.0 in `mod_info.yaml`, minimum supported build 744825, published on the Steam Workshop. Players of ribbon-based automation builds use it.

Top-level folders and key files:

- `src/Bitshifter/`: the mod. `Mod.cs` (entry point and compatibility checks), `Patches.cs` (bit depth, building defs, visuals, display and NOT gate patches), `SideScreen.cs` (the 31-bit selector), `OverlayLabelGuard.cs` (keeps Better Automation Overlay labels working), `anim/` (reader and writer art), `mod.yaml`, `mod_info.yaml`.
- `src/Bitshifter.Tests/`: in-game tests for compatibility, gates, readout, settings, side screen and signals.
- `tools/make_art.py`: generates the building art.
- `README.md`: what the mod does, compatibility, installing and how it works.
- `CHANGELOG.md`: release notes per version.
- `publish/`: Workshop description, tags, preview image and the packaged mod.

The `.context/` documents of this node: [domains](domains/README.md) (entities, glossary), [standards](standards/README.md) (code style, error handling, naming conventions), `decisions/` and `retrospectives/`.

Documents in this folder:

- [entities](entities.md): Ribbon Reader and Writer bit selection, display and NOT gate patches, with the key code paths.
- [glossary](glossary.md): What the mod patches, its rules and its terms.

Documents in this folder:

- [code-style](code-style.md): C# formatting, imports, comments, Harmony patch and component conventions, with this mod's own layout.
- [error-handling](error-handling.md): How the mod guards its Harmony patches, reflection lookups and file reads, and what it logs when something is missing.
- [naming-conventions](naming-conventions.md): File, namespace, patch class, string key and id naming.
